summary.text: Jeff Barry (listed by Ballotpedia as Jeffrey Barry) is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 29 since January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as insurance agency owner.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Barry served in the U.S. Navy.
His career experience includes working as an insurance agency owner, and Ballotpedia lists a prior office on the Pearland Independent School District board, Position 7.
Barry succeeded Ed Thompson in the Texas House, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
